Gate columns shown

The daemon answers this form with the page in the chosen columns, and the address then carries the choice, so a shared link opens as its sender sees it. Keeping the choice for the next visit, and any change of columns in a static export, needs script.

The viewer is the assignee of Views, so the page arrives with each block above open at detail and each provenance closed. An observer, and every reader of a static export, arrives with every block closed and sees the four-row table alone. A contributor arrives at the person form below, with the parents of their tasks open.

The person form

With a person in place of a task, the view shows the tasks the person is assigned or contributes at next, their ancestors up to the root as a spine, and their siblings. The daemon serves it at context.html with no task, for the viewer by default; this mockup draws it beneath the task form. The person form serves a contributor with few tasks. In this project both emails hold most of the tree: noreply@anthropic.com is assigned twenty-seven of the thirty-seven tasks, and nbyoung@nbyoung.com ten, among them the root and the Method and Views branches. The form drawn here is the owner's, which still leaves something out: the twenty-three tasks under 2034. The assignment view lists what each email carries.
